dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jface.platform_getadaptermanager_to_adapters_adapt>
<!description: Replace deprecated Platform.getAdapterManager().getAdapter() with Adapters.adapt() for adapter lookups.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: api-modernization, eclipse>

org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.getAdapterManager().getAdapter($part, $type)
=>
org.eclipse.core.runtime.Adapters.adapt($part, $type)
;;
summary: Replaces a specific method chain to retrieve an adapter with the modern `Adapters.adapt` static method.
